Menu regrouped into five stages in production order: 1 Plan, 2 Build, 3 Review, 4 Publish, 5 Project (Preprod, Prod and Postprod are kept as aliases). The intro now opens with the pipeline: five cards in the same order, each showing where that stage stands right now (scenes and length, draft version and check, what is waiting on you, whether title and thumbnail are chosen). The old card grid and stale stage list are gone. Menu and pipeline both come from spec/menu.json.
Fix: the footer's dependency chips and label now follow each page's light or dark theme (the label was nearly invisible on light pages), and the first Gaps card no longer repeats itself.

Preprod: new Gaps page listing everything that is waiting on you (19 items in 5 groups), what each one blocks, how to deliver it, with a link to where it matters. Every page footer now has a Depends on section with clickable links: pages, data files, generator scripts and external sources. Kanban completed (repo-public, thumbnail face, DeepSeek, Studio comment, practitioner read) and finished work moved to Done.

Draft v2 of the video from your Review notes: hook says 'in the age of AI'; five things now connects every part to AI and says be ready to learn the details; costs say these are average UK figures plus a new lever animation for leverage; exceptions show 'AI helps when the stakes increase'; the email footage frame is much bigger; tracking says 'next journey' and has an n8n logo slot (official logo file needed). Drafts are now versioned (v1 kept, v2 latest). Script 3:38 to 3:54. Review notes cleared.

New Prod page: Desktop app and players. A verdict on whether to use the Hyperframes Studio app (viewer and finishing tool, not the place the generated video is written, because it reformatted every generated file), the three ways to edit, and a detailed player comparison with Remotion's Player and Studio, with emojis. Also: feedback boxes under every scene card on the First draft page.

First draft page: a feedback box under every scene card, so each note is tied to its scene in the copied text. The feedback system now supports a box under any element, and copies notes in page order.
Fix: the Review page's control rows no longer pick up the thin teal progress-bar style from the shared stylesheet, so the buttons and messages no longer overlap.

First draft of the film: built in Hyperframes from the script (one file per scene, AI voice, captions), rendered in 48 s and embedded on a new First draft page under Postprod. New Review page (timestamped notes and drawings on any frame, tied to the script scene, copy for the chat) and Performance page (measured pipeline times and real deploy times). Speed page corrected with the real render time.

Publish page: your selection is marked, the title 'Stuck in Red Tape? How I Use AI When a Process Gets Confusing' and thumbnail A, with a note that the two repeat each other. Spec decision, kanban and recommendations updated. Publish-page notes cleared.

Architecture diagram: shorter node captions so nothing is clipped, labels beside short vertical arrows, and the column labels no longer cut off at the bottom.

Architecture diagram at the top of the hub, with icons, dependency arrows and a dependency table.
